The '''FireStorm Air-to-Ground Missile Rack''' was a model of [[Starship/Legends|starship]]-mounted [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launcher]]. The racks were retractable and held two-hundred and fifty [[Missile/Legends|missiles]] that could be fire singly or in one salvo. The [[HT-2200 medium freighter]] ''[[Reekeene's Retribution]]'' mounted two FireStorm launchers. The launchers could only be fired in [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]].<ref name="SS" />
